mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy), the Federal Reserve's tightening response increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sectors and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When real sales of retail and food services (RSAFS) fall below 650,000 million dollars, it indicates a sharp contraction in consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening labor market and monetary policy, reducing corporate hiring and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: labor market contraction with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 100.0), industrial production falls, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
